name: Escaping Ban'ethil

narrative.details:
My prayers have been answered! I am thankful that you have fought your way down here.

I was sent here by the Oracle Tree to deliver a message to the slumbering druids here only to find it completely overrun by furbolg! They ambushed me before I could turn back and brought me down here--I fear for their next meal.

I don't know about you, but I loathe this place. Under the earth is no place for the kaldorei.
narrative.objectives: Help Sentinel Lynessa Duskblossom escape Ban'ethil Barrow Den, and report her is safety to Sentinel Kyra Starsong in Dolanaar.
narrative.offerRewardText: Thank Elune you were around to help Lynessa avoid a dark fate with the Gnarlpine. She's one of our best, and a personal friend.Please, take this in thanks. May it serve you well in keeping the kaldorei safe.
